# Exercise 3.1
### a)
Estimate parameters
```{r}
# Data
y <- c(1.0, 0.5, 2.0, 2.0, 3.5, 3.0, 4.0)
x <- c(4.0, 4.0, 3.5, 4.0, 2.0, 2.5, 1.5)

# Fit linear regression model
model <- lm(y ~ x)

# Show results
summary(model)

```
$$
  \hat{\beta_1} = 5.7 \\ 
  \hat{\beta_2} = -1.13
$$


### b) 
Consider a variable x_8 = 0.5, what is the 95% interval for Y?

```{r}

# New value
newdata <- data.frame(x = 0.5)

# 90% prediction interval
predict(model, newdata, interval = "prediction", level = 0.90)

```

#### c)
Only using y_t
ie. we make a simple model'
$$
  Y = \mu + \epsilon_t
$$

```{r}
y <- c(1.0, 0.5, 2.0, 2.0, 3.5, 3.0, 4.0)
n <- length(y)

ybar <- mean(y)
s <- sd(y)                 # sample SD with (n-1) in denominator
tcrit <- qt(0.95, df = n-1)

lower <- ybar - tcrit * s * sqrt(1 + 1/n)
upper <- ybar + tcrit * s * sqrt(1 + 1/n)

c(pred = ybar, lower = lower, upper = upper)
```
